scripts.build:go: go build -o bin/mis-server ./cmd/mis-server && go build -o bin/mis-verify ./cmd/mis-verify && go build -o bin/mis-test ./cmd/mis-test && go build -o bin/mis-pack ./cmd/mis-pack && go build -o bin/mis-dev-server ./cmd/mis-dev-server
scripts.build: npm run build:ui && npm run build:go
scripts.test: bash -c 'if [ -z "$1" ]; then echo "Error: test name is required" >&2; exit 1; fi; npx playwright test -g "$1" --workers=1' --
scripts.test:go: bash -c 'if [ -n "$1" ]; then go test -v ./internal/... -run "$1"; else go test -v ./internal/...; fi' --
